standard-dialogue-monologue-1.npc: So there I was, minding my own business on the boat, when I feel us slow to a halt.
This man walks over to me and says that it's my stop, absurd though that is.
So they all sort of... toss me onto this island with a meagre amount of survival objects.
I think they were laughing whilst they did it.
Either way, there I was. Alone. On this island.
I'd paid quite handsomely for my passage too!
A tour to the rainforest, and then dinner in Tal Teklan.
This crew were all so very willing to get me where I wanted to go.
Very helpful as they collected my belongings. Eager, even.
It felt exclusive. I was the only passenger they took aboard.
I do see now that I was perhaps foolish.
Drawn in by their charms, throwing money around.
I just really wanted that dinner in Tal Teklan, you know?
Now I'm going to die alone on an island, bereft of my worldly possessions.
Perhaps the bards of Temptestus will write of my sorrow, should they hear my tale.

standard-dialogue-monologue-2.npc: Excuse me! Hello! I appear to have found myself in a situation here.
Can you see any way for me to... defamiliarise myself with this island?
I'm getting rather bored being stuck here waiting for the tide to swallow me.
Though, that is reliant on me not throwing myself into the dark sea first.
But fear not! I shan't do that, for it would be improper.
Though if it rains again, I may be tempted.
Observe how I have nothing here on this island.
There's myself and the occasional crab, but I've been left here... Abandoned! Forgotten!
I don't suppose you could send for a boat to retrieve me?
Yes, this predicament needs excessive force to be resolved peacefully.
Maybe I should pack a flag next time. Claim this land for myself.

standard-dialogue-monologue-3.npc: No! I can't be stuck here! It's far too small.
Are you finding the air just chokes you here? It is the air, isn't it?
Gosh, it feels as if my skin is just crawling.
Nobody's going to find me here... I'm going to rot on this island alone.
My regular baker will realise I've not come by in a day. He will send a search party!
They will send a search party, won't they?
This island is too small though... They won't be able to see it.
I'd start a fire, if only I had the tools to do so.
This isn't how I was meant to die!
I was meant to go down gloriously in the Colosseum!
